What is a virtual function?

Imagine inventory items. Every item has a use effect, but a ManaPotion specifically restores magic.

```cpp
struct Item { virtual void use() { cout << "Hold"; } };
struct ManaPotion : Item { void use() override { cout << "Restore"; } };
```

This uses <iostream>. A virtual function tells C++ to look for the most specific version of the method in the derived class.

If we store a ManaPotion in an Item pointer, will the Item or ManaPotion version of `use()` run?
